Remember, if the older order can’t be processed within five days, I want to cancel it and know the total refund. For the other, I need to update the shipping address to 1234 Elm St, Springfield, IL, 62701, and confirm the new delivery details and total price. Thanks!

Yes, please go ahead and cancel order #W8268610—the wait has just been too long, so the reason is "no longer needed." I’d like to confirm that I’ll get a full refund of $164.28 back to my credit card.

And yes, please update the shipping address for order #W2702727 to 1234 Elm St, Springfield, IL, 62701. Once you’ve made the change, can you confirm that the order will be delivered to my new address and let me know if the total price of $625.60 stays the same?
Yes, that’s all correct—please proceed with both the cancellation and the address update as you described. Let me know once everything is done and confirmed. Thanks!

Thank you for confirming everything and taking care of my requests. That’s all I needed for now. Have a good day!
